# fabric_slivers (Data Source)

Read per-sliver state for a FABRIC slice from the orchestrator. Use this data source to inspect node, network, and component sliver identifiers and runtime state after a slice is provisioned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read sliver runtime state for a provisioned FABRIC slice.
data "fabric_slivers" "science_gateway" {
  slice_id = "3f1b62c1-7a5e-4f46-b4ea-58d8df8c0d70"
}

output "science_gateway_management_ips" {
  value = [
    for sliver in data.fabric_slivers.science_gateway.slivers : sliver.management_ip
    if sliver.management_ip != ""
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slice_id` (String) FABRIC slice identifier whose slivers should be read.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic data source identifier assigned by the provider.
- `slivers` (Attributes List) Per-sliver state assigned by the orchestrator after provisioning or modification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--slivers))

<a id="nestedatt--slivers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `slivers`

Read-Only:

- `graph_node_id` (String) Graph node identifier associated with the sliver.
- `join_state` (String) Join state when advertised by the orchestrator.
- `management_ip` (String) Management IP address when advertised by the sliver payload.
- `pending_state` (String) Pending sliver state when advertised by the orchestrator.
- `sliver_id` (String) FABRIC sliver identifier assigned by the orchestrator.
- `sliver_type` (String) FABRIC sliver type assigned by the orchestrator.
- `state` (String) Current sliver state assigned by the orchestrator.
